name: MRPC
old_description: MRPC is a world class, FDA Registered, and ISO 13485 certified full contract manufacturer of medical devices, instruments, and disposables. With full range product lifecycle capabilities including design assistance, development, and manufacturing, MRPC is a turn-key manufacturing partner to some of the world’s largest medical device companies.
about:
MRPC is based in Hudson, New Hampshire, where it operates as a full contract manufacturer of medical devices, instruments, and disposables. The company holds FDA registration and ISO 13485 certification, positioning it as a regulated partner for medical production.

Its manufacturing capabilities include silicone molding, plastic molding and extrusions, and multi-material molding, complemented by design assistance, development, and end-to-end manufacturing services that cover the full product lifecycle. The firm also performs finished medical device assembly, offering a turn-key solution for clients.

MRPC serves the medical device sector, working with large medical device companies on programs that range from complex assemblies to automated scaling initiatives, such as its documented work advancing a complex medical device program through integrated engineering and manufacturing.

The company states that its FDA registration and ISO 13485 certification underpin its quality system, enabling it to act as a turn-key manufacturing partner for some of the world's largest medical device companies.
